title: Jaime Maussan's 2023 presentation of the J-type body

tellings.quote: So that so in 2023 out so Haime rolled out the J type which is not my highest conviction body type for being real.

plain: In 2023 a man named Jaime Maussan presented what he called the "J type", one of several kinds of small bodies said to be not human. Michels tells this himself, without naming any other source. He adds that of all the body types put forward, this is not the one he is most convinced is real.
